'''''Tupolev''''' was a [[Nebulon-B2 frigate]] that was part of [[Task Force Vengeance/Legends|Task Force ''Vengeance'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was part of the first wave of [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] ships that were passing through the [[Almaran system]]. [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Command]] had launched multiple [[RZ-1 A-wing interceptor/Legends|A-wings]] piloted by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] to [[Mission to Almaran|inspect]] the ships and to destroy any [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] carrying [[Warhead/Legends|Warheads]] to buy time. The [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] soon launched [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] to intercept the A-wings but the fighters were outwitted and most, if not all of them were lost in the skirmish.
